Home.heroTitle: I am a nurse and I teach other nurses healthcare Finnish.
Home.heroDesc: I'm Rachael, a registered nurse in Finnish A&E and a language coach. I teach the Finnish you actually need on shift: with patients, with colleagues and in your notes.
Home.trust1: For Finnish level B2 and above
Home.who1Body: You already work in Finnish healthcare or you are starting soon.
Home.who2Title: Finnish at B2 level or above
Home.who2Body: You speak Finnish but want more confidence in patient situations and handovers.
Home.who3Body: You have come to work in Finland and you are learning the language and practices of a Finnish workplace.
Home.whyTitle: What I bring to my teaching
Home.why1Body: In the lessons we practise situations from A&E and the wards.
Home.why2Title: My own experience of learning Finnish
Home.why2Body: I have learned Finnish myself, so I know which things are often difficult.
Home.why3Body: Emergency, cardiac, medical and elderly care.
Home.quote: I know what it feels like to struggle with Finnish in a clinical setting. That's why I teach it.
Home.materialsSub: Materials for studying on your own.
Home.how2Body: Tell me briefly what you would like to practise.

About.heroDesc: I work in A&E in Finland. My courses are for nurses who already speak Finnish but want more confidence in work situations: with patients, in handovers and in documentation.
About.bgP1: I graduated in 2005 from JAMK University of Applied Sciences in Jyväskylä.
About.bgP2: I have worked in elderly care, geriatric wards, medical wards, cardiac units, and emergency departments.
About.bgP3: My main experience is in Accident & Emergency.
About.bgP4: I learned Finnish through courses and real work experience and hold certificates from JAMK and the University of Helsinki.
About.bgP5: I teach clinical Finnish to nurses who already have B2 level or higher.
About.clinical1Body: Assessing care needs (triage) and urgent care.
About.clinical2Body: Care and monitoring of cardiac patients.
About.clinical4Body: Care of older patients, from home care to palliative care.
About.philQuote: At work you do not need perfect Finnish. The most important thing is that patients and colleagues understand you, also when there is a rush.
About.philBody: In the lessons we practise real work situations. We go through grammar only as much as is needed.

Courses.heroDesc: All lessons are online, so you can take part alongside shift work. The courses are for nurses whose Finnish is at least at B2 level.
Courses.groupDesc: A group of up to six, where you practise together with other nurses.
Courses.prereq: If you are not sure about your level, contact me and we can check it together.
Courses.individualDesc: Lessons are planned around your needs and your workplace.
Courses.videoDesc: Recorded lessons to watch at your own pace.
Courses.faq1Q: What level of Finnish do I need?
Courses.faq1A: The courses are for nurses whose Finnish is at least at B2 level. If you are not sure about your level, you can book a free introductory call.
Courses.faq2A: All lessons are online in Zoom or Teams. You need a working internet connection and a quiet place.
Courses.faq3Q: Can I take both group and private lessons?
Courses.faq3A: Yes. Many take part in a group and add a few private lessons on topics from their own ward.
Courses.faq4Q: What happens after I sign up?
Courses.faq4A: I contact you, and we agree a short call where we go through your background and the schedule.
